SELECT s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS active_charter_schools,
       SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_2014_2015,
       ROUND((AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pct_frpm_k12,
       ROUND(AVG(sat.combined)::numeric, 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cds, (avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite) AS combined
    FROM satscores
    WHERE avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
) sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.charter = 1
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype
ORDER BY s.fundingtype;

WITH v AS (
  SELECT s.cdscode, s.county, s.school
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.virtual = 'F' AND s.county IS NOT NULL
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT county, count(*) AS n FROM v GROUP BY county
),
top AS (
  SELECT county, n FROM cnt
  WHERE n >= (SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT n FROM cnt ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5) t)
),
scored AS (
  SELECT v.county, v.school, sat.avgscrread,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY v.county ORDER BY sat.avgscrread DESC) AS rk
  FROM v
  JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = v.cdscode
  WHERE sat.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
),
best AS (
  SELECT county, school FROM scored WHERE rk = 1
)
SELECT t.county AS "County", t.n AS "Virtual Schools", COALESCE(b.school, 'None') AS "School"
FROM top t
LEFT JOIN best b ON b.county = t.county
ORDER BY t.n DESC, t.county, b.school;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode, f."School Name" AS school_name, s.county, s.city,
         s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip, s.website, s.opendate, s.closeddate,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enroll, f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_cnt,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS frpm_share,
         t.numtsttakr, t.avgscrread, t.avgscrmath, t.avgscrwrite, t.numge1500
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = f.cdscode
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
    AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
),
parts AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, * FROM base
  WHERE frpm_cnt = (SELECT MAX(frpm_cnt) FROM base)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share', * FROM base
  WHERE frpm_share = (SELECT MIN(frpm_share) FROM base)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes', * FROM base
  WHERE cdscode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT part AS "Part",
       school_name AS "School Name",
       county AS "County",
       city AS "City",
       mailstreet AS "Mailing Street",
       mailcity AS "Mailing City",
       mailstate AS "Mailing State",
       mailzip AS "Mailing ZIP",
       website AS "Website",
       enroll AS "K-12 Enrollment",
       frpm_cnt AS "FRPM Count",
       frpm_share AS "FRPM Share",
       (avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite) AS "Average SAT Total",
       CASE WHEN numtsttakr > 0 THEN 100.0 * numge1500 / numtsttakr END AS "Pct SAT 1500+",
       opendate AS "Open Date",
       CASE WHEN closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS "Status"
FROM parts
ORDER BY CASE part WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1 WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, school_name

SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.langs)::numeric, 2) AS avg_languages
FROM (
  SELECT s.code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) FILTER (WHERE st.translation IS NOT NULL AND st.translation <> '') AS langs
  FROM sets s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON st.setcode = s.code
  WHERE s.releasedate >= DATE '2016-01-01' AND s.releasedate < DATE '2017-01-01'

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS c2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = y.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND c.segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
p AS (
  SELECT segment, ROUND((c2013 - c2012) * 100 / c2012, 2) AS increase_pct
  FROM t WHERE c2012 <> 0
)
SELECT segment, increase_pct
FROM p
WHERE increase_pct = (SELECT MAX(increase_pct) FROM p)
   OR increase_pct = (SELECT MIN(increase_pct) FROM p)
ORDER BY increase_pct DESC;

  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = t.district_id
  LEFT JOIN act ON act.district_id = t.district_id
)
SELECT a2, avg_active_loan FROM res ORDER BY avg_active_loan DESC

  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d0 ON d0.disp_id = c.disp_id

),
top AS (

)

),
base AS (

         w.total_withdrawn,

  JOIN w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id

WITH cl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 3541
),
dr AS (
  SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a4::bigint AS pop, a11
  FROM district
),
regcnt AS (
  SELECT dr.a3, count(*) AS cnt
  FROM client c JOIN dr ON dr.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY dr.a3
),
topd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2 AS top_name, pop AS top_pop
  FROM dr
  ORDER BY a3, pop DESC, district_id
),
rk AS (
  SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY pop DESC) AS rnk
  FROM dr
),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         count(*) AS cnt,
         COALESCE(sum(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS income,
         COALESCE(sum(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'), 0) AS expense
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cl)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.date AS account_opened,
       a.frequency,
       d.a2 AS district_name,
       d.a3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN d.district_id = h.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       d.a11 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(tx.cnt, 0) AS num_transactions,
       COALESCE(tx.income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(tx.income, 0) - COALESCE(tx.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(rc.cnt, 0) AS clients_in_region,
       tp.top_name AS most_populous_district,
       tp.top_pop AS most_populous_population,
       rk.rnk AS population_rank_in_region
FROM cl
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = cl.account_id
JOIN dr d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3541) h
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT status, amount FROM loan
  WHERE loan.account_id = a.account_id
  ORDER BY date DESC, loan_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) l ON true
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN regcnt rc ON rc.a3 = d.a3
LEFT JOIN topd tp ON tp.a3 = d.a3
LEFT JOIN rk ON rk.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT cl.client_id, cl.gender, cl.birth_date, c.type AS card_type,
         (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date))::int AS age_at_issue,
         cl.district_id, d.account_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND c.issued < DATE '1995-01-01'
),
loan_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT b.client_id,
       b.gender,
       b.birth_date,
       b.card_type,
       b.age_at_issue,
       COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(la.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
       CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) > 0 AND b.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
         WHEN COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0) > 0 AND b.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
         ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a11 AS district_avg_salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.gender ORDER BY b.age_at_issue DESC) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = b.district_id
ORDER BY b.client_id;

WITH fem_loans AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, c.client_id, c.birth_date
  FROM loan l
  JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'

  SELECT * FROM fem_loans
  WHERE amount IN (SELECT amount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT amount FROM fem_loans ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3) t)

region_loans AS (
  SELECT dist.a3 AS region, count(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY dist.a3
),
region_salary AS (
  SELECT x.region, round(avg(x.avg_sal)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM (SELECT d.a3 AS region, d.district_id, avg(d.a11) AS avg_sal FROM district d GROUP BY d.a3, d.district_id) x
  GROUP BY x.region
),
trans_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         count(*) AS trans_count,
         sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
  t.client_id,
  t.amount AS loan_amount,
  t.duration AS duration_months,
  round((t.payments * t.duration)::numeric, 2) AS total_payments,
  round((t.payments * t.duration - t.amount)::numeric, 2) AS interest_paid,
  t.status AS loan_status,
  dist.a2 AS district_name,
  dist.a3 AS region,
  coalesce(ta.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  round(coalesce(ta.total_deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(ta.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * t.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN coalesce(ta.total_deposits, 0) > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  rl.loan_count AS region_loan_count,
  rs.region_avg_salary,
  date_part('year', age(DATE '2026-10-09', t.birth_date))::int AS age_2026
FROM top_loans t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON ta.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loans rl ON rl.region = dist.a3
LEFT JOIN region_salary rs ON rs.region = dist.a3
ORDER BY t.amount DESC

WITH gold_accts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM card c JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.account_id IS NOT NULL
),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         sum(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
         sum(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
         count(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) FILTER (WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> '' AND t.account IS NOT NULL) AS ext_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accts)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, count(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accts)
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT g.account_id,
         di.a2 AS district_name,
         di.a3 AS region,
         coalesce(tx.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
         coalesce(tx.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
         coalesce(ln.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         coalesce(tx.ext_counterparties, 0) AS ext_counterparties
  FROM gold_accts g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, ext_counterparties,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ext_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

WITH gold_accts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM card c JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.account_id IS NOT NULL
),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         sum(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
         sum(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
         count(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) FILTER (WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> '' AND t.account IS NOT NULL) AS ext_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accts)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, count(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accts)
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT g.account_id,
         di.a2 AS district_name,
         di.a3 AS region,
         coalesce(tx.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
         coalesce(tx.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
         coalesce(ln.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         coalesce(tx.ext_counterparties, 0) AS ext_counterparties
  FROM gold_accts g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, ext_counterparties,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ext_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

WITH tabor AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened FROM account a WHERE a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE a2='Tabor') AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date FROM disp d JOIN client c ON c.client_id=d.client_id WHERE d.type='OWNER'
),
cards AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM card c JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id=c.disp_id WHERE c.issued<='1996-12-31' GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS n,
    BOOL_OR(status='B') AS has_b, BOOL_OR(status IN ('C','D')) AS has_cd
  FROM loan WHERE date<='1996-12-31' GROUP BY account_id
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type='PRIJEM' THEN amount END),0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN amount END),0) AS money_out,
    MAX(balance) AS peak
  FROM trans WHERE date>='1997-01-01' AND date<='1997-12-31' GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.opened, o.gender,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age,
    COALESCE(cd.n,0) AS num_cards,
    COALESCE(l.n,0) AS num_loans,
    CASE WHEN l.n IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
         WHEN l.has_b THEN 'defaulted'
         WHEN l.has_cd THEN 'repaying'
         ELSE 'paid off' END AS loan_standing,
    COALESCE(x.n_tx,0) AS num_tx,
    COALESCE(x.money_in,0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(x.money_out,0) AS money_out,
    COALESCE(x.peak,0) AS peak_balance
  FROM tabor t
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id=t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cards cd ON cd.account_id=t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id=t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN tx x ON x.account_id=t.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, opened, gender, age, num_cards, num_loans, loan_standing, num_tx, money_in, money_out, peak_balance,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id

WITH owner_classic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id AND c.type = 'classic'
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
qual_acc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oc.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM owner_classic oc
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
),
pay AS (
  SELECT qa.district_id, t.bank, t.account, t.amount
  FROM qual_acc qa
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = qa.account_id AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
)

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.client_id)
     FROM owner_classic oc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
     WHERE a.district_id = di.district_id) AS client_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.bank || '|' || p.account::text)
     FROM pay p
     WHERE p.district_id = di.district_id
       AND p.bank IS NOT NULL AND p.bank <> ''
       AND p.account IS NOT NULL AND p.account <> 0) AS external_account_count,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0)
     FROM pay p
     WHERE p.district_id = di.district_id) AS total_amount
FROM district di
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC

         (split_part(q.q3, ':', 1)::int * 60000 + round(split_part(split_part(q.q3, ':', 2), '.', 2)::numeric)::int + split_part(split_part(q.q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::int * 1000) AS ms
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
  JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
  WHERE d.nationality = 'British' AND d.dob > DATE '1980-12-31' AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3 <> ''
)
SELECT driver_name, race_name, race_year, q3
FROM t
WHERE ms = (SELECT MIN(ms) FROM t)

WITH ital AS (SELECT constructorid, name, url FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'Italian'),
last_race AS (
  SELECT s.constructorid, r.year, s.points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.round DESC, r.raceid DESC) AS rn
  FROM constructorstandings s JOIN races r ON r.raceid = s.raceid
),
season_pts AS (
  SELECT constructorid, SUM(points) AS career_points FROM last_race WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY constructorid
),
totals AS (
  SELECT i.name, i.url, COALESCE(sp.career_points, 0) AS career_points
  FROM ital i LEFT JOIN season_pts sp ON sp.constructorid = i.constructorid
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT t.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS rnk FROM totals t
)
SELECT name, career_points, url FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY rnk, name

sql:
WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
  FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
  WHERE r.position = 1 AND d.dob IS NOT NULL
),
oldest AS (
  SELECT * FROM winners
  ORDER BY dob, (forename || ' ' || surname)
  LIMIT 1
),
firstwin AS (
  SELECT ra.name, ra.date
  FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
  WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM oldest)
  ORDER BY ra.date, ra.name
  LIMIT 1
),
starts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT raceid) AS nd
  FROM results WHERE driverid = (SELECT driverid FROM oldest)
)
SELECT o.forename || ' ' || o.surname AS full_name, o.nationality, f.name AS first_win_race, f.date AS first_win_date, s.nd AS races_started
FROM oldest o, firstwin f, starts s;

WITH z AS (SELECT c.circuitref, r.date, r.time, CASE c.circuitref WHEN 'americas' THEN 'America/Chicago' WHEN 'bahrain' THEN 'Asia/Bahrain' WHEN 'BAK' THEN 'Asia/Baku' WHEN 'buddh' THEN 'Asia/Kolkata' WHEN 'catalunya' THEN 'Europe/Madrid' WHEN 'fuji' THEN 'Asia/Tokyo' WHEN 'hockenheimring' THEN 'Europe/Berlin' WHEN 'hungaroring' THEN 'Europe/Budapest' WHEN 'imola' THEN 'Europe/Rome' WHEN 'indianapolis' THEN 'America/Indiana/Indianapolis' WHEN 'interlagos' THEN 'America/Sao_Paulo' WHEN 'istanbul' THEN 'Europe/Istanbul' WHEN 'magny_cours' THEN 'Europe/Paris' WHEN 'marina_bay' THEN 'Asia/Singapore' WHEN 'monaco' THEN 'Europe/Monaco' WHEN 'monza' THEN 'Europe/Rome' WHEN 'nurburgring' THEN 'Europe/Berlin' WHEN 'red_bull_ring' THEN 'Europe/Vienna' WHEN 'rodriguez' THEN 'America/Mexico_City' WHEN 'sepang' THEN 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur' WHEN 'shanghai' THEN 'Asia/Shanghai' WHEN 'silverstone' THEN 'Europe/London' WHEN 'sochi' THEN 'Europe/Moscow' WHEN 'spa' THEN 'Europe/Brussels' WHEN 'suzuka' THEN 'Asia/Tokyo' WHEN 'valencia' THEN 'Europe/Madrid' WHEN 'villeneuve' THEN 'America/Toronto' WHEN 'yas_marina' THEN 'Asia/Dubai' WHEN 'yeongam' THEN 'Asia/Seoul' END AS tz FROM races r JOIN circuits c USING (circuitid) WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL),
l AS (SELECT circuitref, ((date + time::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE tz)::time AS lt FROM z),
e AS (SELECT DISTINCT circuitref FROM l WHERE lt = (SELECT MIN(lt) FROM l)),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT circuitref FROM l WHERE lt = (SELECT MAX(lt) FROM l)),
g AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((SELECT MAX(lt) FROM l) - (SELECT MIN(lt) FROM l)))::bigint AS gap_seconds)
SELECT e.circuitref AS earliest_circuitref, t.circuitref AS latest_circuitref, g.gap_seconds
FROM e CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN g
ORDER BY 1, 2

sql:
WITH oct_nov AS (
  SELECT e.expense_id, e.cost, e.link_to_member, e.expense_description
  FROM expense e
  WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
items AS (
  SELECT o.link_to_member, lower(trim(x.item)) AS item, o.expense_id, o.cost
  FROM oct_nov o
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(o.expense_description, ',')) AS x(item)
  WHERE trim(x.item) <> ''
),
per_member AS (
  SELECT i.link_to_member,
         COUNT(DISTINCT i.item) AS kind_count,
         (SELECT SUM(o.cost) FROM oct_nov o WHERE o.link_to_member = i.link_to_member) AS total_spent
  FROM items i
  GROUP BY i.link_to_member
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.kind_count DESC) AS rk FROM per_member p
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       r.kind_count,
       ROUND(r.total_spent::numeric, 2) AS total_spending
FROM ranked r
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = r.link_to_member
WHERE r.rk = 1
ORDER BY full_name

high AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.id FROM laboratory l JOIN p ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.gpt >= 60),
normal AS (
  SELECT l.id, MAX(l.gpt) AS max_normal_gpt

  WHERE l.gpt IS NOT NULL AND l.gpt < 60

WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM high)
ORDER BY normal.max_normal_gpt DESC, p.id

WITH normal_sm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM laboratory WHERE sm IN ('negative', '0')
),
no_thrombosis AS (
  SELECT p.id FROM patient p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM examination e WHERE e.id = p.id AND e.thrombosis > 0
  )
),
signif_proteinuria AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id FROM laboratory l
  WHERE COALESCE(
          substring(l."U-PRO" from '\((\d+)\)'),
          substring(l."U-PRO" from '>=(\d+)'),
          CASE WHEN l."U-PRO" ~ '^\d+$' THEN l."U-PRO" END
        )::bigint >= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM normal_sm n
JOIN no_thrombosis t ON t.id = n.id
JOIN signif_proteinuria s ON s.id = n.id;

WITH carbon_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c'
),
atom_stats AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         count(*) AS n_atoms,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS n_c,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS n_cl
  FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_stats AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         count(*) AS n_bonds,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS n_mult
  FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id
),
ctb AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, count(*) AS n_ctb
  FROM bond b
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
  )
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
         COALESCE(a.n_atoms, 0) AS n_atoms,
         COALESCE(bs.n_bonds, 0) AS n_bonds,
         COALESCE(a.n_c, 0) AS n_c,
         COALESCE(a.n_cl, 0) AS n_cl,
         COALESCE(ctb.n_ctb, 0) AS n_ctb,
         COALESCE(bs.n_mult, 0) AS n_mult
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN carbon_mols cm ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_stats a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_stats bs ON bs.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN ctb ON ctb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id, label, n_atoms, n_bonds, n_c, n_cl, n_ctb, n_mult,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n_ctb DESC, n_atoms DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY n_ctb DESC, n_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
